Mumbai Hostel Warden Arrested for Alleged Assault on Two Boys

A hostel warden in Mumbai has been arrested for allegedly assaulting two boys. The incident occurred at the Kandivalis Swagat Ashram, a residential facility for students. Authorities have launched an investigation into the matter. The arrest highlights concerns about safety and accountability within educational institutions.
